verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Fireflies serves an llms.txt at docs.fireflies.ai that indexes markdown docs pages. Fireflies also documents a Documentation MCP Server so AI tools can search its docs, plus an LLM-development guide for feeding a downloadable docs file to AI coding tools. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs resources in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The Fireflies Documentation MCP Server enables AI tools to search and retrieve information directly from the Fireflies documentation.
Upload the downloaded file to your AI coding tool. Instruct your tool to analyze and debug the code using the content of this file.
